# proxmox_backup_job_included_volumes (Data Source)

Lists the volumes a backup job includes, from `/cluster/backup/{id}/included_volumes`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_backup_jobs" "all" {}

data "proxmox_backup_job_included_volumes" "volumes" {
  id = data.proxmox_backup_jobs.all.jobs[0].id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Backup job id.

### Read-Only
